title: Simulstream: Open-Source Toolkit for Evaluation and Demonstration of Streaming Speech-to-Text Translation Systems
abstract: arXiv:2512.17648v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Streaming Speech-to-Text Translation (StreamST) requires producing translations concurrently with incoming speech under strict latency constraints, demanding models that balance low latency with high translation quality. Despite rapid progress, evaluation remains fragmented across existing frameworks, which make different assumptions about how systems operate - for example, whether they process continuous speech or short pre-segmented audio, and whether they support output revision (retranslation) or not (incremental). For instance, SimulEval, the most widely used framework, supports only incremental decoding, assumes short segmented inputs, and lacks a native support for system demonstrations. As a result, comparing systems fairly and consistently across studies remains challenging, with no unified solution for benchmarking and interactive demonstration. To address this gap, we introduce simulstream, the first open-source framework

translated_title: Simulstream：用于流式语音到文本翻译系统评估与演示的开源工具包
translated_abstract: 流式语音到文本翻译（StreamST）要求在严格的延迟约束下与输入语音同步生成译文，这需要模型在低延迟与高翻译质量之间取得平衡。尽管该领域进展迅速，但评估工作在现有框架中仍然碎片化，这些框架对系统的运行方式做出了不同的假设——例如，系统是处理连续语音还是短预分段音频，是否支持输出修订（重翻译）或不支持（增量式）。例如，使用最广泛的框架 SimulEval 仅支持增量解码，假设输入为短分段音频，且缺乏对系统演示的原生支持。因此，在不同研究之间公平、一致地比较系统仍然具有挑战性，目前缺乏用于基准测试和交互式演示的统一解决方案。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 simulstream，首个开源框架……
tldr: 本文提出了simulstream，首个用于流式语音到文本翻译系统评估与演示的开源统一框架，解决了现有评估工具碎片化、运行假设不一致且缺乏交互式演示支持的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces simulstream, the first open-source unified framework for evaluating and demonstrating streaming speech-to-text translation systems, addressing the fragmentation, inconsistent assumptions, and lack of interactive demonstration support in existing evaluation tools.
